ingredients: 5 oz spring greens mix (or any salad greens)
1/2 medium red onion, very thinly sliced
1/2 cup pepitas (or toasted pine nuts, or other nuts/seeds)
1 tbsp freshly squeezed lemon juice (or red wine vinegar)
1 small clove garlic, pressed or finely minced (or 1/2 tsp garlic powder)

steps: Make the dressing: whisk all dressing ingredients together in a bowl (or shake in a jar) until combined.
Make the salad: combine the greens, cucumber, red onion, and pepitas in a large bowl.
Toss with the dressing until evenly combined. Serve immediately.
